title: Seasonal freight
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. An illustrated logistics field-book spread filling the frame: two substantial original watercolor-and-ink views of period orange cargo sled trains amid compacted snow, left smaller grouping under 1959, right larger grouping under 1960. The number of crates is pictorial, not a counted data series. Thin ink ledger lines integrate the factual labels with the drawings. Exact text: CONSTRUCTION FREIGHT; 1959; About 1,000 short tons; 1960; About 4,600 short tons; Two seasons: about 5,600 short tons. Complete trucks/sleds and grounding, no isolated numbers on blank paper. No unlabeled bar heights or invented weights. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
